## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Industrial strength ABOVE TREND (Industrial Strength 1W: +0.79% | 1M: +8.05%) and Energy leadership via XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND, offset by rising credit stress (HYG/LQD showing CREDIT STRESS ↓).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND → HYG/LQD CREDIT STRESS ↓ (↓ falling). Fear mixed: VIX (28.90) (1W: -1.83% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION (↓ falling) but VXX (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising), and reflation signals via CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) alongside SPY/TLT NEUTRAL with Stocks vs Bonds BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -5.01%), while Dollar UUP (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) in CORRECTION → flat.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy and defensives leading: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND, XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND, XLP (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%) ABOVE TREND; Tech weak: XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND and Financials soft: XLF (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US lagging versus pockets of global strength: SPY (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND while EEM (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND and EWJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%) ABOVE TREND; China weak: FXI (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed/speculative appetite subdued: ARKK (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%) RECOVERY, IWM (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND, IBIT (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) BELOW TREND — Speculation index rising but action selective.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation bias: CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND show industrial/energy demand; Gold GLD (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) RECOVERY and Silver SLV (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%) RECOVERY reflect safe‑haven and tactical flows.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy clear strength: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLE and XLU ABOVE TREND (both timeframes positive) and TLT ABOVE TREND confirm reflation + flight‑to‑safety coexistence. Divergence: multiple sector correction flags (XLI and small/mid caps in CORRECTION) — minor divergences, no MAJOR divergence across core ETFs.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Energy/Defensive cyclicals showing strength (XLE, XLU, XLP) and monitor credit spreads and tech weakness; reduce exposure to tech/China risk where appropriate and keep duration via TLT as a ballast.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND if oil stays bid, XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND on yield stability. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND if semis pressure persists, XLF (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND on credit squeeze.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND on reflation. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) BELOW TREND and URA (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -12.09%) BELOW TREND remain vulnerable.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.72 (credit health threshold), XLK/XLF 2.6980 (growth vs value tilt), SPY/TLT 7.55 (stocks vs bonds inflection).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Energy (XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND), Utilities (XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND) and Real Estate (XLRE (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.32%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength. Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND → HYG/LQD CREDIT STRESS ↓) and persistent Tech weakness (XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND) — monitor closely.
